userId.description: The Zoom user ID or email address. Use me when the credential can act on the current app user.

from.description: A UTC date-time in Zoom's yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ form, such as 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z.

to.description: A UTC date-time in Zoom's yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ form, such as 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z.

timeFilterField.description: Which summary time from and to filter on. Zoom defaults to summary_start_time.

pageSize.description: The number of summaries per page. Zoom defaults to 30.

nextPageToken.description: The next_page_token value returned by Zoom for the next page of results.

description: The input payload for listing Zoom meeting summaries.
